description: This file defines the TracesBuilder class, which provides methods to construct and assemble Traces objects from individual trace components such as entries, timestamps, and frame maps. It manages multiple TraceBuilder instances keyed by TraceType and facilitates building a complete Traces collection.

classes.name: TracesBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing Traces objects by aggregating individual TraceBuilder instances for different TraceType categories.

methods.name: setEntries
methods.description: Sets entries for a specific trace type by updating the corresponding TraceBuilder.

methods.name: setTimestamps
methods.description: Sets timestamps for a specific trace type using the appropriate TraceBuilder.

methods.name: setFrameMap
methods.description: Associates a FrameMap with a specific trace type, creating a new TraceBuilder if necessary.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a Traces object composed of all the individual traces built by each TraceBuilder.

methods.name: getOrCreateTraceBuilder
methods.description: Retrieves the existing TraceBuilder for the specified TraceType or creates and initializes a new one.

ctags.name: traceBuilders
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly traceBuilders = new Map<TraceType, TraceBuilder<{}>>();$/

fields.name: private readonly traceBuilders = new Map<TraceType, TraceBuilder<{}>>();
